item.title: Crochet Possum Frogged It Again Feeling Great
item.description: A blank-staring possum clutches a tangled heap of unravelled yarn, frogged again and feeling great about it. A funny gift for crocheters and knitters who restart every project. Find it on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Silly Goose Crochet Yarn Stash Is a Plan
item.description: A contented goose sits on a big pile of yarn balls and insists it's not a stash, it's a plan. It suits crocheters and knitters whose yarn collection keeps growing and makes a funny gift. Available on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
